ns2:course.label: Comparative Oncology
ns2:course.description: Comparative study of the nature of mammalian and avian neoplasms based on general and special methods of tumor identification and classification; lectures, demonstrations, and laboratory. Prerequisite: VM 605 and VM 608, or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: VM 605 and VM 608, or equivalent.
